kind.description:
Dictates which connectors to render on the node. If not defined, does not render any connectors.
`input`: Indicates that this node is an input to other nodes (ie. is a source node). There are no
         edges expected with this node as the target node.
`output`: Indicates that this node is an output for other nodes (ie is a terminal node). There are no
         edges expected with this node as the source node.
`passthrough`: Indicates that this node can be both input and output and will have ports for both.
`island`: Indicates that this node has neither inputs nor outputs.

color.description: The color associated with this node in RGB form. When specified, the border and background will match this color.

icon.description: Font awesome icon associated with this node. Will be rendered on the left hand side of the node.

iconColor.description: Icon color associated with this node.

additionalComponent.description: Component that will be rendered inside of group node.
